00045 FSinOscUGenInternal::FSinOscUGenInternal(UGen const& freq, const float initialPhase, const int channel) throw()
00046 :   UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00047     currentFreq(0.0),
00048     b1(0.0),
00049     y1(0.0),
00050     y2(0.0)
00051 {   
00052     inputs[Freq] = freq;
00053     
00054     if(inputs[Freq].isScalar(channel))
00055         currentFreq = inputs[Freq].getValue(channel);
00056     
00057     double w = currentFreq * twopi * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate();
00058     b1 = 2. * std::cos(w);
00059     y1 = std::sin(initialPhase);
00060     y2 = std::sin(initialPhase-w);
00061     
00062     initValue(y1);
00063 }
00064 
00065 UGenInternal* FSinOscUGenInternal::getChannel(const int channel) throw()
00066 {   
00067     return new FSinOscUGenInternal((float)currentFreq, 0.f, channel);
00068 }

00075 void FSinOscUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00076 {   
00077     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00078     float newFreq = *(inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00079     double y0;
00080     
00081     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, b1);
00082     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, y1);
00083     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, y2);
00084     
00085     if(newFreq != currentFreq)
00086     {
00087         currentFreq = newFreq;
00088         
00089         double initialPhase;
00090         
00091         if((1.0-std::abs(y1)) < 0.00001)
00092         {
00093             initialPhase = y1 > 0.0 ? pi2 : -pi2;
00094         }
00095         else
00096         {
00097             initialPhase = std::asin(y1);
00098             // based on the trajectory predict which solution of asin(y1) is correct..
00099             if(y2 >= y1)
00100             {
00101                 double piVersion = y1 > 0.0 ? pi : -pi;         
00102                 initialPhase = piVersion - initialPhase;
00103             }
00104         }
00105 
00106         double w = currentFreq * twopi * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate();
00107         b1 = zap(2. * std::cos(w));
00108         y1 = zap(std::sin(initialPhase));
00109         y2 = zap(std::sin(initialPhase-w));
00110     }
00111     
00112     int filterLoops = UGen::getFilterLoops();
00113     while(filterLoops--)
00114     {
00115         y0 = b1 * y1 - y2;
00116         *outputSamples++ = y0;
00117         y2 = b1 * y0 - y1;
00118         *outputSamples++ = y2; 
00119         y1 = b1 * y2 - y0;
00120         *outputSamples++ = y1; 
00121     }
00122     
00123     int filterRemain = UGen::getFilterRemain();
00124     while(filterRemain--)
00125     {
00126         y0 = b1 * y1 - y2;
00127         *outputSamples++ = y0; 
00128         y2 = y1; 
00129         y1 = y0;
00130     }
00131     
00132 //  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00133 //  for(int i = 0; i < numSamplesToProcess; ++i)
00134 //  {
00135 //      y0 = b1 * y1 - y2;
00136 //      outputSamples[i] = y0;// = b1 * y1 - y2; 
00137 //      y2 = y1; 
00138 //      y1 = y0;
00139 //  }
00140         
00141     y1 = zap(y1);
00142     y2 = zap(y2);
00143     LOCAL_COPY(b1);
00144     LOCAL_COPY(y1);
00145     LOCAL_COPY(y2);
00146 }
